thread:
Kai - Partner PM: Quick kickoff for TerraChannel co-sell POC. Main asks: SSO/SAML, entitlements (dedicated cache + quant), telemetry webhook, and pricing tier options. Target: 2-week trial.

Jordan - Sales Eng: Noted. Do they need Dedicated from day one for SLA? We can start hosted but pricing/commit will differ. Propose draft: dev tier (no commit) -> $0.XX/token; reserved 4x GPU commit -> $12k/mo baseline. Thoughts?

Nadia - Partner (Terra Systems): They expect 99.9% SLA and want SAML + SCIM. Prefer reserved for production, but open to hosted for POC. Also need KMS + VPC peering.

Lucy - Solutions Eng: For POC I'll spin up chat on gpt-small-open, 300 sample convs and an eval harness. Need sample SSO metadata and any dataset redaction rules.

Samir - Platform Eng: Telemetry options: webhook (real-time) or batch S3 export. Webhook uses HMAC-SHA256 header. Example header: X-Signature: sha256=...

onboard-bot: tenant terrachannel-poc created (id: t-cc7b1). Console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/t-cc7b1

Kai - Partner PM: Action list:
- Jordan: formal pricing draft + commit scenarios (Thu)
- Samir: webhook payload example + egress IPs (EOD)
- Lucy: dataset + harness (Wed)
- Nadia: drop SSO metadata + compliance doc to shared folder

Nadia - Partner (Terra Systems): Uploaded SSO metadata to S3: https://s3.terra/terrachannel/sso.xml. Compliance checklist sent.

Samir - Platform Eng: Egress IPs: 3.22.11.0/24, 18.205.0.0/16. Telemetry PII toggle available to hash/redact before forwarding. I'll attach a minimal runbook to the repo.

Jordan - Sales Eng: I'll prepare the two-tier pricing + a sample contract paragraph for reserved capacity.

Kai - Partner PM: Great. Check-in Fri 10am PT unless blockers. :thumbsup:
